walkthroughs.body_html:
Area of Study 2: Instrumental Music — a core area of A-Level Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area of Study 2: Instrumental Music brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area of Study 2: Instrumental Music.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How many semitones are in a perfect fifth?
options: 5 (counting letter-name positions).

mcqs.q: How does a harmonic minor scale differ from a natural minor?
options: It has only five notes.
All notes are raised by a semitone.
The seventh degree is raised by a semitone (creating a leading note).
